description: Colour themes, in the order Settings lists them. The interface is written in Corporate Blue colours, named here by role (brand: application name; button_fill, button_outline, button_hover, selection; window_background; panel: the darker colour of panels, fields and lists). A theme without accent keeps them. Otherwise every blue's luminance is multiplied by luminance(accent) / luminance(anchor role), keeping the ratios, and its hue turned to the accent's: by the same shift (keep_hue_offsets, the default) or exactly the accent's hue; match_chroma makes every colour as vivid as the accent. overrides set a role's colour outright. id: stored in the settings, never change it (midnight_blue is Corporate Blue's from an earlier name). hover_shades: in themes with an accent, hover and selection are these shares of the button fill's luminance. light_tints: scaled luminances above knee are compressed below lightest, so light colours stay tints instead of white.
